appearance.organs.flower.shape.rays.why: A head card draws each ray floret of a radiate head as a ray.

appearance.organs.flower.shape.disc.why: A head card draws the disc about as wide as the involucre, with a ray's length beyond it on either side: the disc's share of the head's width.

traits.inflorescence_unit.note: VicFlora's family description: the flowers sit packed on a shared receptacle in heads (capitula), each almost always ringed by an involucre of bracts.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: VicFlora's family description: leaves one or two to a node, rarely more; it names neither as the usual state.

traits.fruit_type.note: VicFlora's family description: the fruit is usually a cypsela (a one-seeded fruit from an inferior ovary), often topped by a pappus.

rules.note: How PlantGen's cards draw the daisy family's heads, a choice of the model's until heads are built from their florets (spec rework M6): a head card draws one head face on, its rays the ray florets' straps round a disc of florets, and an array of heads is a cluster of such heads (spec rework L1). A head's width is its involucre's, as floras measure it, plus a ray on either side.
